snippet.title: 『Entered』Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
About This Game
『Entered』 is a retro-style horror visual novel set in a high school literature club.

Features
• Retro CRT monitor-style 4:3 aspect ratio
• 256-color VGA pixel graphics with scanline effects
• Extensive use of FMV-style video sequences
• A visual novel where the story changes based on player choices
• Multiple horror experiences spanning psychological horror, mystery, occult horror, and more
• Character fates and endings that vary depending on the route
(The DEMO contains no choices, and you can play through the full "ASSIMILATION" route!)

Streaming Guidelines
Both commercial and non-commercial streaming are allowed.
Please include a link to the game's store page in the content description and/or description box.
The estimated playtime is approximately 30–40 minutes.
